Because 1 of my friend was telling me that his peer sahab says "rooh chhoti si kale rang ki hoti hai".But I have given him the refrence of verse of Quran Ch-17 V-85 which is contradictory with the statement of peer sahab.Please guide me. Question: Assalamualikum wr wbtuhu, 1)I want to know that what is the concept of spirit(rooh) in islam ? Because 1 of my friend was telling me that his peer sahab says "rooh chhoti si kale rang ki hoti hai".But I have given him the refrence of verse of Quran Ch-17 V-85 which is contradictory with the statement of peer sahab.Please guide me. Jazakallahu khairan ... Answer ID: 5277 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 740/693=D/1429) The Holy Quran has replied to the question regarding 'Ruhu (spirit) ' saying: قل الروح من امر ربي و ما اوتيتم من العلم الا قليلا ?Say: the spirit (comes) by command of My Lord: of knowledge it is only a little that is communicated to you?. (Al-Quran, Surah Isra, 85) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
